data.long_meaning: Girja is derived from the Sanskrit word 'gir' which means 'beloved' or 'dear one'. In Hindu mythology, Girja is a name of the goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. The name Girja carries the meaning “Beloved, Dear One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
